text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Infrastructure and Environment Committee under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A-2, for a term of office starting on January 11, 2021, and ending November 14, 2022.

The Infrastructure and Environment Committee: 1. Elected Councillor James Pasternak as Vice Chair of the Infrastructure and Environment Committee for a term of office starting on January 11, 2021, and ending November 14, 2022.
